body: Light-path claim: (1) exhaustive study of the owner-provided external harness reference - prompt engineering, thinker construction, end-to-end request processing, and every supporting aspect, recorded as a reference-only review doc in LocalMind terms; (2) retire the zero-provider canned greeting path (bare 'Hi' must reach the model like any other turn - owner: hardcoded answers are not the design; canned strings stay provider-down-fallback only); (3) apply the study's first concrete prompt-architecture fixes where they map to queued row B-2026-10-31-25.
